translation.fr: Detecte les regions ou une metrique est significativement plus ELEVEE (hotspot, rouge) ou plus BASSE (coldspot, bleu) que la moyenne globale, en tenant compte du voisinage spatial. Calcul rapide (pas de permutation), synchrone -- pas de barre de progression necessaire.
translation.en: Detects regions where a metric is significantly HIGHER (hotspot, red) or LOWER (coldspot, blue) than the global average, accounting for the spatial neighborhood. Fast computation (no permutation), synchronous — no progress bar needed.

translation.en: For each pair of labels (cluster, dominant cell type or niche), compares the number of observed neighborhoods to a null envelope obtained by randomly shuffling labels — a positive z-score signals spatial co-occurrence (e.g. tumor/stroma interface), negative mutual exclusion.

translation.en: For ONE target label, compares its observed spatial aggregation to a null envelope obtained by reshuffling WHO carries that label among the same positions (random labeling) — the usual adaptation in spatial transcriptomics (the whole tissue is the window, not a Poisson process) rather than a true CSR/spatstat test.

translation.en: scCODA effects are Bayesian CREDIBLE INTERVALS (spike-and-slab prior) — not p-values; "credible" denotes a direct posterior probability at the recorded FDR threshold.

translation.en: The composition unit is the SAMPLE — cells are not biological replicates. The reference identity is a scientific assumption (assumed unchanged), displayed on every figure.

translation.en: The model covers the chosen pair of conditions; scCODA does not interpret Milo neighbourhoods — both methods remain distinct results (descriptive cross-views in stage 16).

translation.fr: Vues croisées DESCRIPTIVES : Milo teste des VOISINAGES (régions d'un graphe), scCODA teste la COMPOSITION par échantillon — deux grandeurs différentes, jamais fusionnées.
translation.en: DESCRIPTIVE cross-views: Milo tests NEIGHBOURHOODS (graph regions), scCODA tests per-sample COMPOSITION — two different quantities, never merged.

translation.fr: Les cellules ne sont pas des réplicats biologiques : chaque vue porte le contexte de composition par échantillon. Un désaccord peut provenir des échelles, des effectifs ou d'une biologie captée différemment — rien ne tranche.

translation.fr: Déclarez la condition et le réplicat de chaque échantillon. Une CONDITION est une propriété de l'échantillon (pas de la cellule). Sans elle, les analyses A-vs-B (pseudobulk, Milo/scCODA, plots par condition) restent inaccessibles.
translation.en: Declare the condition and replicate of each sample. A CONDITION is a sample-level property (not per cell). Without it, A-vs-B analyses (pseudobulk, Milo/scCODA, per-condition plots) stay unavailable.

translation.fr: Éditez directement les cellules condition / replicate dans le tableau. Réplicat vide = l'échantillon EST le réplicat.
translation.en: Edit the condition / replicate cells directly in the table. Empty replicate = the sample IS the replicate.

translation.en: Harmony corrects batch BEFORE clustering (clusters, markers and DA derive from the integrated space). Recommended from 2 samples on; ignored if < 2 batches.
